<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum the most intense ion is at m/z 268.194, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈267.1867 Da. Matching this exact mass to plausible organic formulas (C, H, O, N) and considering the isotopic pattern (≈20 % M+1 intensity, indicating ~16‑18 carbons) points to the formula C₁₆H₂₇O₃, which matches the mass within a few ppm.</thought>
<final_answer>C16H27O3</final_answer>
